news.text: Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) is undergoing season ending surgery to treat his shoulder injury.
news.analysis: The young tight end had struggled to get going this year, and this only amplifies those struggles. It's a tough blow to Arroyo and his value in dynasty will certainly take a hit.
